column1: # Driven by `just test-cdirect-<arch>`, which injects `/bin/cdirect`. The binary is
# `tools/hello.c` compiled by clang and linked by LLD against `libc.a`, the arch's
# `crt0` and `tools/minix-user.ld`; the fork's rustc is not in the link line. The
# expectation is a whole line, so it cannot be satisfied by the echoed command.
